reason: The repository owner explicitly directed creation and GitHub publication of the two upgraded releases after the V6 handoff disclosed completed automated and Antigravity CLI checks and the uncompleted live-host benchmark. This record applies that publication direction to the versioned candidate. It records no independent human approval and no live dogfood result. Executable source remains frozen at the signed candidate; all technical publication gates remain mandatory.

risk_acceptance.independent_reviewer: Publication proceeds under the owner's stated direction. Independent Antigravity CLI execution is automated testing, not an independent GitHub human pull-request approval, and is not represented as one.
risk_acceptance.live_dogfood: Publication proceeds with the previously disclosed live-host benchmark limitation. Retrospective, synthetic, local, and CI checks are not represented as uncontaminated baseline-versus-candidate live dogfood.
